title: MoFlow：多目标智能体工作流生成
summary: MoFlow 将智能体工作流生成建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，利用凸包蒙特卡洛树搜索与乐观集合值回传，使单次搜索即可近似覆盖帕累托前沿，从而无需重训练即可按任意偏好返回工作流。在六个基准上取得最高平均超体积。
summary_en: MoFlow formulates agentic workflow generation as a multi-objective Markov decision process, solved via Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search with optimistic set-valued backups. Each node stores a set of reachable trade-offs instead of a single weighted score, so one search approximately covers the Pareto front and can return a workflow for any preference without retraining. It achieves the highest average hypervolume across six benchmarks.
